items.sentence: The strong bear displayed the muscle in its furry arm.
The small rabbit takes a regular morning run around the field.
The house cat often chooses to stretch its legs after a nap.
A young cook will reduce the sugar in the fruit pie.
The helpful opponent shook hands after the chess match ended.
A sports teacher will recommend soft shoes for the long walk.
One yellow sign will warn hikers about the slippery path.
Today, too little sleep was the cause of the sleepy yawns.
Today, do not lose the small key to the garden gate.
The young dog wore a loose collar around its soft neck.
